Heart palpitations after drinking alcohol  [Highlight start] can range from brief, harmless flutters to a short-term abnormal heart rhythm called **holiday heart syndrome** (most commonly atrial fibrillation, or AFib) [Highlight end] . They often happen during drinking, a few hours later, or the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF153BxR0ryaT54r30iR0-vSIoE6S_5D1QPpco_dI_lcsVRt9i7lgp2JrwZWIN3vf4L5WOqkePy74EyyYjmuBoPApi62QKM3Wxxu-FNnS111GW4p85_0Yxqm3ESawZAAg4UZWvPX2y1HjmryDAzpV59e0mdjcFKCvobHunYA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF14hCuZ8RLepfsMC6z1ntMefJqU_pf9dBu5uPNgxkP0ylfscn-OLlzZGC2FEdRqnNpDSQPBwhZRVrz8Kj74h954fjRYnIAtv2jDum9pN2Tg25eYH6112Y85g8EjbDOswC_3_QtC1oUehrg5iNt8Cm83T7XFvhddB2hPH8MuS600zlEneFJRB3xEYRhkS481pcbKzNH9PmtuG_Fznm9mnnW4VhzFG1)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXtmRaOmBn7TgTdqAriXYfsM2SuHjvWkmObalflf3GHs3jc5iC5Sue2Mz-EwCSkRpI3XZ2wZNbrxXZY2eCWk5oIgJkGcrceJ_bF5NymYq-yuZUMzujbA7mFQ7fhx-aRHlX)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF13rigjYpNQZGP7dXFom0laQXf_qis49HC7C3nx8VJRE5Ls4l6YrjR6IDuEJroa0A5YdXZ6QBSjuSHpvAu7KfuoTZgDoU0zxSMKMGBE_DQgHp4qUuFCFbJnAcIv0Q-ncr17tVMsoFF4Uuy6_m-gCwA8urob5BM2GuZLlJUVwkKA9JirgPrK_oEeFEAvpGeYvK8Ula2oId)

### Common Causes

- **Electrical and nervous system shifts:** Alcohol can irritate the heart's electrical signaling and trigger a rebound stress response (higher adrenaline and blood pressure) as your body clears it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF14TFK1m1HTcurXdqsCIyfp7K0l5lbwsr0Id_CweITIRKz-TT-93kiAmp6i_LSItP9JLxd3EaSL12llbkj4E_J44jTxt4Vbmd7JTEP4QdVKl08kcwytQ7-iyxC6JjPNgxjW-AAFwhvzteUdMuRNYOPu5246NEfv6TyVILPu7WCkKk_A9ucHp07RiSvRbdOfVAP6gsriA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXzmDgnBs4mxMtdNeaIlhSWC679Z3_MeMh9kF8_jtTCwFaxsXJ7701rN_41lY6IXdKX-psmH6j-uHU6K3D7gi8uDM2-x8K5vjgW58-_QcTg7S8mwb3eIAzYLkKJ1kxfwle5IveLFuq)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXHj4OPuZGzpHFG0mjukT5yB4KsH6vVId2npUzvUnG6RnjlTutjOrpy64WueHoOAr_blNvnBCL0ccvVhIl136q7ltypas2v1SGXh65pevBpxG-OD_HNwj97d6LLM1_bOkdIAUlXT6v)
- **Dehydration and electrolyte loss:** Alcohol increases urination, which can throw off electrolytes needed for steady heartbeats.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF153BxR0ryaT54r30iR0-vSIoE6S_5D1QPpco_dI_lcsVRt9i7lgp2JrwZWIN3vf4L5WOqkePy74EyyYjmuBoPApi62QKM3Wxxu-FNnS111GW4p85_0Yxqm3ESawZAAg4UZWvPX2y1HjmryDAzpV59e0mdjcFKCvobHunYA)
- **Holiday heart syndrome:** Heavy or binge drinking can trigger temporary AFib—even in people without known heart disease—often resolving within 24 hours, though it carries risks like stroke if untreated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXxwbTqmx73PHAl48mUBBQAsLYdQew5aKMe5Tsp6hewO9nbmu9gVp3ZfrmSbhKJUWqQv6LHyVxgY387xuADmIittOPu0gq-6FmBDBaIaxXYnwDeaikaLPINIIxDI7zoLq-m2NmmnBrFw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF153BxR0ryaT54r30iR0-vSIoE6S_5D1QPpco_dI_lcsVRt9i7lgp2JrwZWIN3vf4L5WOqkePy74EyyYjmuBoPApi62QKM3Wxxu-FNnS111GW4p85_0Yxqm3ESawZAAg4UZWvPX2y1HjmryDAzpV59e0mdjcFKCvobHunYA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXzmDgnBs4mxMtdNeaIlhSWC679Z3_MeMh9kF8_jtTCwFaxsXJ7701rN_41lY6IXdKX-psmH6j-uHU6K3D7gi8uDM2-x8K5vjgW58-_QcTg7S8mwb3eIAzYLkKJ1kxfwle5IveLFuq)
- **Anxiety ("hangxiety"):** Rebound anxiety and poor sleep after drinking can make a racing or pounding heart more noticeable.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXzmDgnBs4mxMtdNeaIlhSWC679Z3_MeMh9kF8_jtTCwFaxsXJ7701rN_41lY6IXdKX-psmH6j-uHU6K3D7gi8uDM2-x8K5vjgW58-_QcTg7S8mwb3eIAzYLkKJ1kxfwle5IveLFuq)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF14TFK1m1HTcurXdqsCIyfp7K0l5lbwsr0Id_CweITIRKz-TT-93kiAmp6i_LSItP9JLxd3EaSL12llbkj4E_J44jTxt4Vbmd7JTEP4QdVKl08kcwytQ7-iyxC6JjPNgxjW-AAFwhvzteUdMuRNYOPu5246NEfv6TyVILPu7WCkKk_A9ucHp07RiSvRbdOfVAP6gsriA)

Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF13rigjYpNQZGP7dXFom0laQXf_qis49HC7C3nx8VJRE5Ls4l6YrjR6IDuEJroa0A5YdXZ6QBSjuSHpvAu7KfuoTZgDoU0zxSMKMGBE_DQgHp4qUuFCFbJnAcIv0Q-ncr17tVMsoFF4Uuy6_m-gCwA8urob5BM2GuZLlJUVwkKA9JirgPrK_oEeFEAvpGeYvK8Ula2oId) agree that palpitations can show up hours after drinking due to dehydration, electrolyte shifts, or anxiety, though underlying arrhythmias can also be triggered. For a thorough breakdown of symptoms, diagnosis, and care, see the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF153BxR0ryaT54r30iR0-vSIoE6S_5D1QPpco_dI_lcsVRt9i7lgp2JrwZWIN3vf4L5WOqkePy74EyyYjmuBoPApi62QKM3Wxxu-FNnS111GW4p85_0Yxqm3ESawZAAg4UZWvPX2y1HjmryDAzpV59e0mdjcFKCvobHunYA) guide on holiday heart syndrome or learn more about alcohol and rhythm disturbances from [Banner Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF14hCuZ8RLepfsMC6z1ntMefJqU_pf9dBu5uPNgxkP0ylfscn-OLlzZGC2FEdRqnNpDSQPBwhZRVrz8Kj74h954fjRYnIAtv2jDum9pN2Tg25eYH6112Y85g8EjbDOswC_3_QtC1oUehrg5iNt8Cm83T7XFvhddB2hPH8MuS600zlEneFJRB3xEYRhkS481pcbKzNH9PmtuG_Fznm9mnnW4VhzFG1).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF13rigjYpNQZGP7dXFom0laQXf_qis49HC7C3nx8VJRE5Ls4l6YrjR6IDuEJroa0A5YdXZ6QBSjuSHpvAu7KfuoTZgDoU0zxSMKMGBE_DQgHp4qUuFCFbJnAcIv0Q-ncr17tVMsoFF4Uuy6_m-gCwA8urob5BM2GuZLlJUVwkKA9JirgPrK_oEeFEAvpGeYvK8Ula2oId)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF153BxR0ryaT54r30iR0-vSIoE6S_5D1QPpco_dI_lcsVRt9i7lgp2JrwZWIN3vf4L5WOqkePy74EyyYjmuBoPApi62QKM3Wxxu-FNnS111GW4p85_0Yxqm3ESawZAAg4UZWvPX2y1HjmryDAzpV59e0mdjcFKCvobHunYA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF14hCuZ8RLepfsMC6z1ntMefJqU_pf9dBu5uPNgxkP0ylfscn-OLlzZGC2FEdRqnNpDSQPBwhZRVrz8Kj74h954fjRYnIAtv2jDum9pN2Tg25eYH6112Y85g8EjbDOswC_3_QtC1oUehrg5iNt8Cm83T7XFvhddB2hPH8MuS600zlEneFJRB3xEYRhkS481pcbKzNH9PmtuG_Fznm9mnnW4VhzFG1)

### When to Seek Care

- **Get emergency care right away** if palpitations come with chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath, fainting or dizziness, confusion, or an irregular heartbeat that will not settle.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF15GUhI0IG_RuaN5EPJ_xVpB8nZWiIZQ2OHfsgJWMGFU2noJLnqx8qx3i_p4vkbmh_N0y8aEzzmENt4aYkGrHp2LUMP0YJ2TLkG2tQfDXJ2MyNoLB1tSInsTomEoweq9W9gZUX_NgqD0lsfUetIqswvWFVIq7HJKAFiglrtcND5pMpLOdUgol6nJtyUc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF14TFK1m1HTcurXdqsCIyfp7K0l5lbwsr0Id_CweITIRKz-TT-93kiAmp6i_LSItP9JLxd3EaSL12llbkj4E_J44jTxt4Vbmd7JTEP4QdVKl08kcwytQ7-iyxC6JjPNgxjW-AAFwhvzteUdMuRNYOPu5246NEfv6TyVILPu7WCkKk_A9ucHp07RiSvRbdOfVAP6gsriA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXl-ywAE5ChtVbiIOwX-Ru_2Sx8kGwtuSjnvb8xD9ZF3utXOgcqVmYvRXvWwTVqsNKG67rA6Buqx92N58QImF6vDyJTDqn8ouZ1OBVmx_Kyb4dqB518-_qOUnkMgXCHFfG)
- **Schedule a doctor's visit** if palpitations keep happening after drinking, occur on days you do not drink, or you have a personal or family history of heart issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF14TFK1m1HTcurXdqsCIyfp7K0l5lbwsr0Id_CweITIRKz-TT-93kiAmp6i_LSItP9JLxd3EaSL12llbkj4E_J44jTxt4Vbmd7JTEP4QdVKl08kcwytQ7-iyxC6JjPNgxjW-AAFwhvzteUdMuRNYOPu5246NEfv6TyVILPu7WCkKk_A9ucHp07RiSvRbdOfVAP6gsriA)
